documents.unit: Rutgers Office of Information Technology (all campuses)
documents.title: Guidance on the use of AI at Rutgers
documents.quality_note: Universitywide guidance: AI not permissible for coursework unless instructors say so; cites Academic Integrity Policy 10.2.13 ('impermissible technologies'). Same page serves all three Rutgers campuses.

notes: Only the universitywide Rutgers guidance (shared by all campuses) was found; no Camden-specific AI policy or Camden computing unit policy surfaced.
